@@ -0,0 +1,77 @@
+import mongoose from 'mongoose'
+import { Schema } from 'mongoose'
+
+
+const userSchema = new Schema({ 
+
+  profilePhoto:{
+    type: String,
+      // unique:true
+   },
+
+    fullName: {
+      type: String,
+      // unique:true
+     },
+
+     username: { 
+       type: String,
+      required: true,
+      unique:true
+       },
+
+password:{
+      type: String,
+      required: true
+   },
+   
+    phoneNumber:{
+      type: String,
+      unique:true 
+     },
+
+    email:{
+      type: String,
+      required: true,
+      unique:true
+     },
+
+   country:{
+    type: String,
+    // required:true
+   },
+
+   preferredLanguage:{
+      type: String,
+      // required:true
+   },
+   
+    //  resetToken:{
+    //   type: String,
+    //  },
+
+    //  resetExp: {
+    //   type: String,
+    //  },
+
+     role:{
+      type: String,
+       enum: ['admin', 'user', 'r', 'superAdmin'],
+      default: 'user',
+       required: true
+     },
+
+     activityStatus: {
+      type: String,
+      enum: ['isSuspended', 'isPermited'],
+      default: 'isPermited',
+      required: true
+     },
+
+},
+{timestamps: true}
+);
+
+
+const User = mongoose.model('User', userSchema);
+export default User;
\ No newline at end of file
